description:
You are a laboratory safety officer reconciling a chemical inventory against authoritative reference data. Using the CAMEO Chemicals website (https://cameochemicals.noaa.gov/), look up the following five chemicals and create a structured identity report.

Chemicals to look up:
1. Acrolein
2. Methyl isocyanate
3. Boron trifluoride
4. Dimethyl sulfate
5. Titanium tetrachloride

For EACH chemical, search on CAMEO Chemicals and record:
- Chemical name
- CAS Registry Number (in XXX-XX-X format)
- Chemical formula
- Molecular weight

Save the report as a plain text file at: ~/Documents/chemical_identity_report.txt

Format each entry clearly, for example:

Acrolein
CAS: 107-02-8
Formula: C3H4O
Molecular Weight: 56.06

(Use the actual values from the CAMEO Chemicals datasheets. Include all five chemicals in the report.)
